rules.description: useQuery must declare response type generic: useQuery<ResponseType, ErrorType>
staleTime must be explicitly set to prevent constant refetching
Error type must be the second generic of useQuery, not implicit unknown
queryFn must delegate to a typed fetcher function; raw fetch() inside queryFn is forbidden
select transform must be stable — defined outside component or wrapped in useCallback
queryKey factory must be exported for use by mutation invalidation and tests
If any params are required, enabled: !!param guard must be present to prevent undefined queries
